owner_message_original: По поводу движения нашего персонажа по лобби, хотелоь бы видеть прыжок и после спринта, который на shift. Он само собой должен быть чуть дальше и выше.
owner_message_english_translation: Regarding our character's movement through the lobby, I would like a jump from sprinting on Shift too. Naturally it should be a little farther and higher.
decision: Enable a jump from the actual Shift fast-movement state, with modestly higher takeoff and farther travel than the ordinary jump, retaining normal jump behavior and coherent landing recovery.
scope: Purchased lobby gameplay only, over PurchasedArms03. No remapping of Shift or Alt, new art, original protagonist work or lobby architecture. Verification follows FocusedVerification01.
